# mt2.ui.text

Draw text in the current window.

```lua
mt2.ui.text(text: any): boolean
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `any` | `Required` | Converted to text, at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes per widget. |

## Contract

- **Returns:** boolean
- **Thread:** Framework callbacks; native object/camera/time reads verify the game thread.
- **When to call:** Only within ui.window or a render callback.
- **Effects:** Draws a widget.
- **Reload:** Subscriptions owned by the old instance are removed on a successful replacement.
- **Persistence:** No implicit persistence.
- **Capabilities:** `ui`
- **Since:** 1.0.0
- **Stability:** stable-within-api-1

## Errors

- Invalid arguments raise a Lua error.
- A required capability or unavailable adapter raises an error.

## Example

This complete example is also available under `examples/ui/main.lua` in the source and SDK documentation bundle. Native effects require the real game.

```lua
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
local enabled, amount = true, 5
mt2.ui.window("My mod", function()
    mt2.ui.text("Hello, MT2!")
    enabled = mt2.ui.checkbox("Enabled", enabled)
    amount = mt2.ui.number("Amount", amount, 1, 10)
    if mt2.ui.button("Say hello") then mt2.log.info("Hello from my mod") end
end)
```
